title: Senior ServiceNow Developer
description:
**Hello,**
**FCM part of FCTG** 
 is one of the world’s largest travel management companies and a trusted partner for nationals and multinational companies. With a 24/7 reach in 97 countries, FCM’s flexible technology anticipates and solves client needs, supported by experts who provide in\-depth local knowledge and duty of care as part of the ultimate personalised business travel experience.
   

  

 As part of the ASX\-listed Flight Centre Travel Group, FCM delivers the best market\-wide rates, unique added\-value benefits, and exclusive solutions.
   

  

**Winner of the World's Leading Travel Management Company Award at the WTM for nine consecutive years (2019\-2011\),** 
 FCM is constantly transforming the business of travel through its empowered and accountable people who deliver 24/7 service and are available online and offline. FCM has won the coveted
 **Great Place to Work certification for the fifth time** 
 ! FCM Travel India is one of India’s Top 100 Great Mid\-size Workplaces 2024 and the Best in Professional Services.
   

  

 A leader in the travel tech space, FCM has proprietary client solutions. FCM provides specialist services via FCM Consulting and FCM Meetings \& Events.
   

  

**Day in the life:**
 This role will contribute to the overall success and adoption of capability within the ServiceNow platform. As a driven individual you will work closely with key stakeholders to understand their requirements and problems, then designing solutions that are in line with platform governance.
   

  

**You'll be perfect for the role if you have:**
 The successful candidate will be responsible for, but not limited to, the following duties
   

  

* Communicating technical problems and solutions to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Consulting with business analyst/project manager to develop appropriate technical solutions.
* Documenting and gain acceptance / approvals of selected final solutions.
* Executing technical solutions in capacity as a ServiceNow lead and Subject Matter Expert.
* Coaching and advising other Developers and Support Engineers
* Develop, test and implement Client Scripts, Business Rules, UI Policies, UI Actions, and ACLs including advanced scripting of each, forms workflows, and custom Service Portal widgets
* Ensure proper operation and configuration of the platform through testing and validation.
* Develop, test, and implement data integrations via API calls to various other technologies within our Platform environment.
* Administration of the application, including but not limited to, installation and/or upgrading, configuration, operation, and maintenance.
* Advance the maturity of the environment by researching and implementing new tools and technologies.
* Working and collaborating in a team environment.


**Requirement**
* 5\+ years of experience as a developer on the ServiceNow Platform
* Experience working in an Agile or Scrum software development environment
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow components such as Change Management, Service Catalog, Service Portal, Problem Management, Incident Management, CMDB, Knowledge Management, etc.
* Knowledge of HTTP, REST, and API design best practices. Understanding of event\-driven architectures. Understanding of asynchronous programming concepts. Knowledge of modern web design (CSS, HTML, etc.), JavaScript, and Angular.
* Certification \- ServiceNow Certified System Administrator,ServiceNow Certified Application Developer


**Work Perks! \- What’s in it for you:**
 FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.
   

  

 You will be rewarded with competitive market salary. You will also be equipped with relevant training courses and tools to set you up for success with endless career advancement and job opportunities all over the world.
   

  

**Market Aligned remuneration structure** 
 and a highly competitive salary
   

  

**Fun and Energetic culture** 
 : At the heart of everything we do at FCM is a desire to have fun and be yourself
   

  

**Work life Balance** 
 : We believe in “No Leave \= No Life” So have your own travel adventures with paid annual leave
   

  

**Great place to work** 
 \- Recognized as a top workplace for 5 consecutive years, which is a testimonial of our commitment towards our people
   

  

**Wellbeing Focus** 
 \- We take care of our employee with comprehensive medical coverage, accidental insurance, and term insurance for the well being of our people.
   

  

**Paternity Leave:** 
 We ensure that you can spend quality time with your growing family
   

  

**Travel perks** 
 : You'll have access to plenty of industry discounts to ensure you continue to broaden your horizons
   

  

**A career, not a job** 
 : We believe in our people brightness of future. As a high growth company, you will have the opportunity to advance your career in any direction you choose whether that is locally or globally.
   

  

**Reward \& Recognition** 
 : Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering \- You'll have to experience it to believe it!
   

  

**Love for travel** 
 : We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
   

  

**We value you...**
 Flight Centre Travel Group is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace that supports your unique identity to create better, safer experiences for everyone. We encourage you to come as you are; to foster inclusivity and collaboration. We celebrate you.
   

  

**Who We Are...**
 Since our beginning, our vision has always been to open up the world for those who want to see.
   

  

 As a global travel retailer, our people come from all different backgrounds, and our connections spread to the far reaches of the globe \- 20\+ countries and counting! Together, we are a family (we call ourselves Flighties).
   

  

 We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve. We embrace new experiences, we celebrate the wins, seize all opportunities, and empower all of our people to find their
 **Brightness of Future.**
 We encourage you to
 **DREAM BIG** 
 through collaboration and innovation, and make sure you are supported to make incredible ideas a reality. Together, we deliver quality, innovative solutions that delight our customers and achieve our strategic priorities.
   

  

**Irreverence. Ownership. Egalitarianism \#FCMIN**

title: Sr. Software Engineer I - API
description:
**Who We Are**
 Zinnia is the leading technology platform for accelerating life and annuities growth. With innovative enterprise solutions and data insights, Zinnia simplifies the experience of buying, selling, and administering insurance products. All of which enables more people to protect their financial futures. Our success is driven by a commitment to three core values: be bold, team up, deliver value – and that we do. Zinnia has over $180 billion in assets under administration, serves 100\+ carrier clients, 2500 distributors and partners, and over 2 million policyholders.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 Sr Software Engineer I, Tech Lead plays a key role in the design, development/configuration, unit testing, installation, and ongoing maintenance of Zinnia software platforms. Technical Lead work with stakeholders to develop solutions and/or products that fulfill the needs of Zinnia’s internal stakeholders and clients. Those solutions and/or products help Zinnia and Zinnia clients to be more efficient and provide better service to end customers. Technical Lead interacts directly with project managers and business stakeholders and may periodically interact directly with Zinnia’s clients. Technical Lead will facilitate, lead, and enable junior team members by acting as a mentor for soft skills and/or technical subject matter experts.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Work as part of a global, cross\-functional team to develop innovative software for Zinnia’s stakeholders.
* Contribute to projects by creating well\-designed, customized, testable, and efficient code for SE2 platforms.
* Assist our teams in providing ongoing support, troubleshooting, improvements, or custom enhancements to existing Zinnia platforms.
* Flexibility to support the challenging development and delivery needs of Zinnia.
* Collaborate with our global teams, internal stakeholders, and customers.
* Act as a mentor and technology expert for team members and conduct technical reviews.
* Architect, Design, develop and validate various requirements for the Zinnia platforms.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, recognize and react to changing business needs and effectively prioritize tasks.
* Must be self\-motivated and able to work independently and in conjunction with team members and business units. Enthusiasm and flexibility to work on a variety of projects.


**What You’ll Need**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; or equivalent related professional experience
* 7\-11 years of experience with languages like JavaScript, Go, Java, Python or Ruby.
* Experience with writing REST APIs and documenting them using Open API specs.
* Patience and perseverance to overcome challenges, solve problems, and learn new computer languages and techniques.
* Working knowledge of managing APIs via API gateways (Kong is preferable).
* Working knowledge of OAuth, SAML, OpenID Connect protocols.
* Effective communication, interpersonal, and critical thinking skills. Effective troubleshooting skills.


**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?**
 At Zinnia, you collaborate with smart, creative professionals who are dedicated to delivering cutting\-edge technologies, deeper data insights, and enhanced services to transform how insurance is done. Visit our website at www.zinnia.com for more information. Apply by completing the online application on the careers section of our website. We are an Equal Opportunity employer committed to a diverse workforce. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

title: Senior Firmware Engineer
description:
Job Title
 **:** 
 Firmware Design Engineer
 



 Location: Noida
 



 Experience: 3 to 5 years
 



 Qualification: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics \& Communication, Electrical, Embedded Systems, or Computer Engineering
 



 Work Schedule: Full\-Time
 



  





 We’re hiring a Firmware Design Engineer to design, develop, and optimize next\-generation electronic products, with a focus on wireless, audio, hearables, and wearables. As the Firmware Design Engineer, your responsibilities would be:
 


* Design, develop, and maintain real\-time embedded firmware in C/C\+\+ using RTOS (FreeRTOS, ThreadX, Zephyr) for microcontrollers and processors.
* Implement device drivers (UART, SPI, I2C, I2S, ADC/DAC, USB) and integrate low\-power firmware for battery\-operated devices.
* Develop and integrate wireless stacks including Bluetooth (Classic \& BLE), WiFi, RF subsystems, and handle OTA updates.
* Build audio processing pipelines, manage digital audio interfaces (I2S, PDM, PCM), ANC/ENC systems, and low\-latency audio.
* Perform board bring\-up, hardware\-software integration, system debugging (JTAG, SWD, Oscilloscope), and root cause analysis.
* Optimize firmware for power consumption, memory footprint, and CPU utilization while maintaining coding standards and documentation.



  





 Requirements
 


* Strong programming skills in Embedded C/C\+\+ with ARM Cortex\-M or RISC\-V microcontrollers.
* Hands\-on experience with RTOS\-based development, hardware protocols (SPI, I2C, UART, USB), bootloaders, and OTA updates.
* Experience with Bluetooth Classic/BLE, WiFi stack integration, and RF communication subsystems.
* Background in low\-power architecture, battery management, and ultra\-low\-power design for wearable or hearable devices.
* Proficiency with debugging tools (JTAG, SWD, Logic Analyzers) and build environments (Git, Keil, STM32CubeIDE, VS Code).
* Ability to read hardware schematics/datasheets and perform hardware\-software board bring\-up.



  





 Benefits
 


* Work with cutting\-edge wireless, audio, and next\-gen wearable/hearable technologies.
* Be part of a collaborative, innovation\-driven work culture with strong growth opportunities.
* Gain hands\-on exposure to market\-leading SoCs (Nordic, Qualcomm, NXP, STM, TI) and LE Audio developments.
* Receive competitive compensation while driving impactful product development from R\&D to market.

title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Principal Software Engineer (Infrastructure)** 




**Location\- Noida Sector 62** 




  





**Job brief:** 




 We are looking for a
 **Principal Engineer** 
 to set the technical direction for our infrastructure organization. In this role, you will partner with engineering leadership to define multi\-year infrastructure strategy, identify and drive cross\-cutting initiatives, and raise the technical bar across multiple teams.
 



 You will operate with significant autonomy on ambiguous, high\-impact problems, and your influence will extend well beyond the code you personally write. You will be a force multiplier — making other engineers more effective, shaping architecture decisions across the org, and representing the engineering function in conversations with senior leadership, partner teams, and external stakeholders.
 



 Your goal is to ensure that our infrastructure is a long\-term competitive advantage: reliable, secure, scalable, and a delight for developers to build on.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Define and own the multi\-year technical roadmap for infrastructure, reliability, and developer productivity, in partnership with engineering leadership and product stakeholders.
* Drive cross\-team and cross\-org initiatives that span multiple quarters, breaking down ambiguous problems into executable workstreams for senior engineers.
* Set architectural standards for large\-scale distributed systems, including service design, data systems, networking, and platform abstractions.
* Own the reliability posture of the organization — define SLOs, error budgets, and the operational practices (golden signals, incident response, capacity planning) that teams are expected to follow.
* Identify and eliminate entire categories of toil and operational risk, not just individual instances.
* Lead the technical strategy for the developer platform — what we build in\-house, what we buy, what we contribute to upstream — and ensure the platform scales with the engineering org.
* Set the security and compliance bar for infrastructure, partnering with security engineering on threat models, controls, and audit readiness.
* Partner with application teams during high\-severity incidents — able to dive into production Node.js and Go services, read code you didn't write, and drive debugging to root cause.
* Mentor senior and staff\-track engineers, conduct architecture reviews, and uplevel the engineering practices of teams you partner with.
* Represent the engineering organization externally — technical interviews at the senior level, conference talks, open source contributions, and vendor/partner technical discussions.
* Make build\-vs\-buy, cloud strategy, and major migration decisions, and own the technical narrative for them with executive stakeholders.



  





**Requirements and skills:** 



* 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a substantial portion spent on infrastructure, platform, or SRE at scale.
* Demonstrated track record of leading initiatives that span multiple teams and multiple quarters, with measurable business and engineering impact.
* Expert\-level proficiency in at least one systems language (Go and Python strongly preferred), and the ability to be productive in others as needed.
* Strong ability to debug production applications written in Go and Node.js — comfortable with profilers, tracers, and runtime diagnostics (pprof, delve, goroutine dumps, Node.js inspector, clinic.js, heap snapshots, flame graphs), and able to reason about event loops, garbage collection, concurrency primitives, and memory leaks in both runtimes.
* Deep expertise in large\-scale distributed systems design — consensus, replication, sharding, caching, eventual consistency, failure modes, and the tradeoffs between them.
* Expert knowledge of networking at L3, L4, and L7, including how this manifests in cloud environments (VPC design, service mesh, load balancing, ingress, mTLS).
* Hands\-on experience with API gateways (Kong, Envoy, AWS API Gateway, Apigee, Tyk, or similar) — including custom plugin development, rate limiting and quota strategies, auth flows (OAuth, JWT, mTLS), traffic shaping, and operating gateways at scale as a critical piece of north\-south traffic infrastructure.
* Deep expertise across at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and working familiarity with the others. Has owned non\-trivial cloud architecture and cost decisions at the org level.
* Expert in Kubernetes — including authoring operators, managing cluster upgrades and migrations at scale, and designing multi\-tenant platform abstractions on top of Kubernetes for application teams.
* Strong experience designing CI/CD systems and developer workflows that scale to hundreds of engineers and thousands of services.
* Deep operational expertise with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Mimir, Loki, ELK, New Relic, or equivalents) — has defined the observability strategy, not just consumed it.
* Strong working knowledge of multiple database systems (MongoDB, MySQL, Postgres) including their operational characteristics, failure modes, and when to choose which.
* Expert with infrastructure\-as\-code and configuration management (Terraform, Ansible, or similar), including how to structure these systems for hundreds of contributors.
* Strong security instincts — has set security standards for infrastructure, not just followed them.
* Excellent technical writing and communication skills — can write design documents that align stakeholders, and can present technical strategy to both engineers and executives.
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority — building consensus across teams that don't report into you.



  





**Nice to have:** 



* Experience with live streaming and video infrastructure at scale — AWS MediaLive, MediaPackage, MediaConvert, IVS, or equivalent services on other clouds (e.g., GCP Live Stream API, Azure Media Services), as well as open source equivalents.
* Hands\-on experience with the broader live video stack: ingest protocols (RTMP, SRT, WebRTC, RIST), packaging and delivery formats (HLS, DASH, CMAF, low\-latency HLS/LL\-DASH), transcoding pipelines, DRM, and CDN strategy for live workloads.
* Understanding of the operational characteristics of live streaming — origin/edge scaling, multi\-region failover for live events, latency budgets, concurrency spikes, and observability for QoE metrics (rebuffering, startup time, bitrate).
* Open source contributions, especially to projects in the Kubernetes / CNCF ecosystem, observability tooling, API gateway / service mesh projects (Kong, Envoy, Istio), video/streaming infrastructure (e.g., FFmpeg, GStreamer, Pion, OvenMediaEngine), or major language ecosystems.
* Conference talks, published technical writing, or other public technical presence.
* Experience scaling an engineering organization through a major growth phase or through a major architectural transition (e.g., monolith decomposition, multi\-region, multi\-cloud).

 We are looking for an experienced SAP BDC Consultant to support SAP ECC/S/4HANA environments where Batch Data Communication (BDC) is used for bulk data uploads, data migration, and transaction automation. The consultant will work closely with functional, technical, and data teams, especially in the context of a broader Microsoft Fabric data modernization initiative.

* Design and develop BDC assets and scripts for automated data upload and conversion into SAP systems.

* Conduct unit testing, data validation, and post\-migration reconciliation.
* Optimize BDC performance for large data volumes and ensure scalability.
* Document migration processes and maintain technical artifacts for audit and compliance.
* Provide support during cutover and hypercare phases of SAP data migration.
* Design, develop, and maintain SAP BDC programs using ABAP
* Record and analyze SAP transactions using SHDB
* Implement BDC solutions using Session Method and Call Transaction Method
* Support bulk uploads for master and transactional data (Material, Vendor, Customer, FI, MM, SD objects)
* Handle screen\-level validations, error handling, and logging mechanisms

* Hands\-on experience with SHDB recordings and BDC program development

* Experience handling large\-scale data uploads and migrations

* Ability to work with functional consultants and business users

title: Agentic AI Developer
description:
Role Overview
 



 We are looking for an enthusiastic and technically strong Agentic AI Developer. The selected candidate will contribute to the development of Agentic AI\-based productivity solutions. These solutions will leverage Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, enterprise APIs, business applications, documents, databases, and knowledge repositories to automate tasks and improve employee productivity.
 



  





 Candidates who have strong software development fundamentals and basic exposure to Generative AI/LLMs, but who may not yet have extensive professional AI experience.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Agentic AI Development
 



 •Design, develop, test, and enhance AI\-powered productivity applications.
 



 •Develop AI agents capable of understanding user requests, reasoning through tasks, and invoking appropriate tools or APIs.
 



 •Implement LLM\-based features using commercial and/or open\-source AI models.
 



 •Develop solutions using LLMs, Prompt engineering, RAG, Vector search, Function/tool calling, AI agent workflows, API integrations
 



 •Experiment with different AI models and frameworks to identify appropriate approaches for business use cases.
 



  





 Application Development
 



 •Develop production\-quality applications using Python, C\#, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar technologies.
 



 •Build REST API integrations with enterprise applications and SaaS platforms.
 



 •Work with databases, files, documents, and structured/unstructured enterprise data.
 



 •Develop reusable components and services for AI applications.
 



 •Write unit tests and perform debugging and troubleshooting.
 



 •Participate in code reviews and follow established software development practices.
 



 AI/RAG Solutions
 



 •Build basic Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.
 



 •Connect AI applications to enterprise knowledge sources.
 



 •Work with document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, and response generation.
 



 •Evaluate AI responses for accuracy, relevance, consistency, and usefulness.
 



 •Improve prompts and retrieval strategies based on evaluation results.
 



  





 Mandatory Skills
 



 Software Development
 



 Candidates must have:
 



 •Strong programming fundamentals in at least one of: Python — preferred, C\#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript
 



 •Good understanding of Object\-oriented programming, Data structures and basic algorithms, REST APIs, JSON, SQL/database fundamentals, Git/version control
 



 •Debugging and troubleshooting
 



 Extensive professional AI experience is not mandatory.
 



  





 Good\-to\-Have Skills
 



 Exposure to any of the following will be an advantage:
 



 AI Platforms \& Frameworks
 



 •Microsoft CoPilot, CoPilot studio, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph, Hugging Face
 



  





 Education
 



 Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent technical discipline.

title: SoC Hardware Architect
description:
**Business Line Description**
* NXP's MPU Engineering (ACE) team is a central engineering organization responsible for developing and delivering Systems\-on\-a\-Chip (SoCs) for NXP's Automotive, Edge, and Radar Processing business lines. MME's SoC Hardware Architecture team produces architectural solutions covering the very wide\-range of SoCs required by the business lines. The team is challenged to produce industry\-leading solutions covering very cost\-sensitive, low power devices to highly\-integrated, high performance, multi\-domain devices compliant with the latest automotive and industrial safety and security standards.


**Job Summary**
* Experience in architecting complex SoCs in leading\-edge process nodes involving multiple processors, coherent/non\-coherent interconnects, memory controllers, Ethernet interfaces, high bandwidth accelerators, high speed connectivity peripherals like PCIe etc
* Work with cross\-functional architecture teams to develop holistic system\-level SoC platform architectures targeting a specific product class or developing a specific technology solution which is scalable across a wide\-range of product types and tiers.
* Deliver architecture specifications which include detailed system\-level use\-case definitions, hardware/software partitioning, alignment with existing industry standards, and relevant key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Collaborate with design and execution teams throughout the entire product development cycle to ensure your solution is successfully deployed in commercial product.
* Developing specifications for both internal and 3rd\-party IP, participating in make v. buy analysis, and selecting the right IP.


**Key Challenges**
* Experience in designing or architecting complex SoCs in leading\-edge process nodes with multiple independent compute environments.
* Exposure to ISO26262\-compliant and mixed\-criticality architectures.
* Deep knowledge of ARM architecture specifications.
* Expertise in one or more the following technical areas: coherent and non\-coherent interconnect, DDR memories, interconnect/system memory QoS, power \& operating state management, PCIe, USB, networking, debug, boot, virtualization, machine\-learning compute, or multimedia \& pixel processing.
* Ability to work at the system\-level, identifying optimal partitioning of solutions between hardware and software, working closely with software architects.
* Track record of assessing performance, power, and area tradeoffs and determining the correct balance for a given product type.
* Experience in defining IP components to solve system issues.


**Job Qualifications**
* Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering or other similar discipline with at least 15 years of relevant experience.
* Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science with 10 or more years of experience preferred.

* Experience mentoring engineers and improving technical practices across a team.

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Patch/Deployment Management
description:
**Req ID:** 
 373588
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Patch/Deployment Management to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN\-UP), India (IN).
   

  

 Role Overview Patch Management \& Software Deployment is a senior hands\-on technical role within NTT DATA's Enterprise Endpoint Management (EPM) practice. This individual owns the design, execution, and continuous improvement of enterprise patch management and software deployment operations across Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) and Microsoft Intune for one or more enterprise client accounts.
   

  

 At Grade 9, the engineer operates with a high degree of independence on complex patching and deployment challenges, serves as the L3 escalation point for patch and software deployment issues within the team, and actively contributes to process governance, automation, and junior team development. The role is critical to client patch compliance posture, vulnerability remediation SLA adherence, and software lifecycle discipline across large, diverse endpoint estates.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Patch Management – SCCM / MECM**
* Design and govern the end\-to\-end software update management lifecycle in SCCM — from SUP synchronisation through ADR execution, deployment targeting, and compliance reporting.
* Architect and maintain WSUS topology — upstream/downstream server configuration, product and classification scoping, synchronisation schedules, and cleanup routines.
* Build and manage Automatic Deployment Rules (ADRs) for Patch Tuesday, out\-of\-band, and zero\-day update scenarios across tiered deployment ring strategies.
* Define and enforce maintenance window frameworks across server, workstation, and critical asset device collections aligned to client change management policies.
* Manage phased patch deployment pipelines — Pilot, UAT, and Production ring progressions with dwell periods and compliance gates.
* Monitor patch compliance dashboards and produce client\-facing SLA compliance reports; drive remediation for non\-compliant devices.
* Govern Software Update Point (SUP) health — synchronisation failures, WSUS certificate management, expired update cleanup, and IIS health monitoring.
* Manage third\-party patch management integration within SCCM where applicable — SCUP, or third\-party update catalogue publishing.
* Lead post\-patch validation activities — confirming deployment success, identifying failed devices, and driving re\-deployment or manual remediation workflows.


**Patch Management – Microsoft Intune / Windows Update for Business**
* Design and manage Windows Update for Business (WUfB) update ring policies in Intune for Quality Updates, Feature Updates, and driver update management.
* Configure and maintain Feature Update policies and Windows 11 readiness targeting for Intune\-managed device populations.
* Govern Intune update compliance reporting — identify deferred, failed, and non\-compliant devices and drive resolution within SLA.
* Manage Expedite Update workflows in Intune for emergency/zero\-day patch scenarios requiring accelerated deployment.
* Align Intune update ring configurations with SCCM co\-management patch workload authority assignments to prevent policy conflicts.
* Support Windows Autopatch readiness assessment and onboarding activities for eligible client environments.


**Software Deployment – SCCM / MECM**
* Lead application and software deployment design in SCCM — MSI, MSIX, EXE, and script\-based deployments with accurate detection rules, supersedence chains, and dependency modelling.
* Build and manage SCCM deployment types, requirement rules, and global conditions for complex multi\-platform application targeting.
* Design and govern phased deployment pipelines for critical software rollouts — piloting, staged production expansion, and rollback capability.
* Manage SCCM application catalogue health, deployment monitoring, and failed deployment investigation across client device estates.
* Govern SCCM Distribution Point (DP) content management — content pre\-staging, validation, redistribution, and bandwidth throttling for remote site deployments.
* Lead software lifecycle management within SCCM — application versioning, supersedence, retirement, and catalogue hygiene.
* Support Software Metering configuration for licence compliance monitoring and usage reporting.


**Software Deployment – Microsoft Intune**
* Build and manage Win32 application deployments in Intune — IntuneWinAppUtil packaging, detection rules, requirement rules, and dependency targeting.
* Manage LOB app, Microsoft Store for Business, and MSIX package deployments in Intune with appropriate assignment targeting.
* Govern app deployment monitoring and remediation — resolve installation failures, assignment conflicts, and detection rule mismatches.
* Manage Intune app supersedence and update workflows for deployed Win32 and LOB applications.
* Support PowerShell script and remediation deployment via Intune for configuration enforcement and break\-fix automation.


**Compliance Reporting \& Vulnerability Remediation**
* Produce and maintain patch compliance dashboards in SCCM SSRS, Power BI, or equivalent reporting tooling for client account review.
* Integrate patch compliance data with vulnerability management outputs (Qualys, Tenable, Defender Vulnerability Management) to drive prioritised remediation workflows.
* Maintain SLA compliance tracking for patch deployment targets — Critical, High, Medium, and Low severity update timelines.
* Lead monthly patch reporting packs for client QSR (Quarterly Service Review) inputs and governance reporting.
* Identify systemic compliance failures — analyse root causes (hardware, connectivity, agent health, exclusions) and drive permanent fixes.


**Automation \& Scripting**
* Develop and maintain PowerShell automation for SCCM patch operations — ADR management, collection membership, compliance queries, and remediation scripts.
* Build Microsoft Graph API integrations for Intune patch compliance reporting, update ring management, and bulk device operations.
* Automate WSUS maintenance routines — expired update decline, computer cleanup, and synchronisation health monitoring.
* Create PowerShell\-based deployment health check scripts for post\-patch and post\-deployment validation.


**Documentation, Governance \& Mentoring**
* Author and maintain patch management SOPs, runbooks, deployment playbooks, and maintenance window calendars.
* Represent patch and deployment changes in the client CAB (Change Advisory Board) process — RFC preparation and impact assessment.
* Provide L3 technical guidance and mentoring to Grade 7 and Grade 8 engineers on patch and software deployment operations.
* Conduct peer reviews of deployment configurations, ADR setups, and compliance reporting produced by junior team members.
* Contribute to EPM practice knowledge base, lessons learned documentation, and internal technical communities.


**Required Skills**
**SCCM / MECM – Patch \& Deployment**
* SCCM Current Branch – Software Update Management: SUP, WSUS, ADR, Maintenance Windows, Phased Deployments (advanced level)
* Application deployment – MSI/MSIX/EXE, detection rules, supersedence, dependency modelling, phased rollout
* Distribution Point management – content prestaging, bandwidth throttling, remote DP operations
* SCCM reporting – SSRS built\-in reports, custom compliance queries, WQL collection queries
* Third\-party patch integration – SCUP or third\-party catalogue publishing experience (desirable)
* Co\-management – patch workload authority, Intune/SCCM policy conflict avoidance


**Microsoft Intune – Patch \& Deployment**
* Windows Update for Business (WUfB) – update rings, Feature Update policies, driver management, expedite workflows
* Win32 app packaging and deployment – IntuneWinAppUtil, detection rules, requirement rules, dependency
* Intune compliance and update reporting – built\-in reports, Graph API\-based custom reporting
* Remediation scripts and PowerShell deployment via Intune
* Intune co\-management alignment – patch workload and policy authority coordination with SCCM


**Vulnerability \& Compliance Integration**
* Integration of patch compliance with vulnerability management tools – Qualys VMDR, Tenable, or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management
* SLA\-based patch compliance tracking and executive reporting
* Power BI or SSRS for patch compliance dashboard development


**Scripting \& Automation**
* PowerShell – advanced scripting for SCCM patch operations, WSUS maintenance, Intune automation
* Microsoft Graph API – Intune patch compliance, update ring management, bulk device operations
* WMI/CIM – SCCM device collection queries, patch state interrogation


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD\-102\) – held or in progress
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ\-104\)
* ITIL v4 Foundation
* Experience with Windows Autopatch assessment and onboarding
* Familiarity with SCCM CMG (Cloud Management Gateway) for internet\-based patch management
* Exposure to Qualys VMDR, Tenable.io, or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management integration with SCCM/Intune
* Prior experience delivering patch compliance in regulated environments — ISO 27001, HIPAA, SOX, or PCI\-DSS


 Experience Profile
   

  

* 9–12 years of progressive experience in enterprise endpoint management.
* Minimum 5 years of hands\-on SCCM/MECM Software Update Management and application deployment experience.
* Minimum 2 years of Microsoft Intune WUfB and Win32 application deployment experience.
* Proven track record managing patch compliance across multi\-site enterprise estates of 5,000\+ endpoints.
* Experience working in managed services, IT outsourcing, or large enterprise IT delivery models preferred.


 Minimum Education
   

  

* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline.
* MCA or equivalent postgraduate qualification considered with commensurate experience.

title: UI Architect
description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 UI Architect (Frontend Platform \& Micro\-frontends)
   

  

**Location:** 
 India
   

  

**Experience:** 
 15\+ Years
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 Engineering Manager
   

  

**About the Role \& the Team** 
 We are building a foundational Core UI Platform Team to own, scale, and govern the frontend ecosystem for our enterprise product suite.
   

  

 As the UI Architect, you will set the technical direction for our frontend platform and guide engineering teams in building scalable, secure, and maintainable user experiences. This is a hands\-on leadership role that combines architecture, platform ownership, technical governance, and active contribution to core platform capabilities.
   

  

 Your mission is to evolve a robust frontend platform through reusable components, shared libraries, developer tooling, and CI/CD practices that help product teams deliver high\-quality software faster and more consistently.
   

  

**Success in this Role** 
 Success will be measured by:
   

  

* Adoption of shared platform capabilities.
* Reuse of common components.
* Improved engineering productivity.
* Reduced technical debt.
* Consistent architecture across teams.
* Platform reliability and performance.
* Faster onboarding of frontend engineers.
* Successful framework and dependency upgrades.


**What You Will Do (Responsibilities)**
* Frontend Platform Architecture: Own the technical vision and architectural integrity of the micro\-frontend ecosystem, including routing, shared state, configuration, and integration patterns.
* Design Systems \& Shared Libraries: Lead component\-driven architecture by evolving shared UI components, design\-system packages, and non\-visual utilities that are performant, well documented, and strongly typed.
* Hands\-on Execution: Write high\-quality, production\-ready code. Tackle the most complex technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and core feature implementations alongside your Technical Lead and UI Developers.
* Tooling \& CI/CD: Own frontend build systems and GitLab CI/CD pipelines. Improve dependency management, container builds, and code\-quality gates to support fast, reliable deployments.
* Governance \& Standards: Establish and enforce standards for code quality, automated testing (Jest, Playwright), accessibility, and security. Introduce formal processes like Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) to document technical choices.
* AI\-Assisted Engineering: Define practical standards for using AI coding assistants and agentic workflows to improve frontend engineering productivity, code quality, and developer experience.
* Mentorship: Act as a force multiplier. Mentor Technical Leads and Senior UI Engineers, conduct rigorous code reviews, and elevate the overall engineering culture.


**What You Bring (Must\-Have Qualifications)**
* 15\+ years of software engineering experience, including architectural ownership of enterprise\-grade frontend platforms or large\-scale UI products.
* Expert\-level React, JavaScript \& TypeScript: Deep knowledge of React architecture, rendering optimization, modern JavaScript, and advanced TypeScript patterns.
* Frontend Architecture: Proven experience designing and delivering component\-driven, micro\-frontend, or platform\-based frontend architectures. Experience with single\-spa or similar orchestration frameworks is preferred.
* SaaS \& Multi\-Tenant Architecture: Strong understanding of designing secure enterprise SaaS applications, including authentication, authorization, Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), and multi\-tenant architectures.
* State, Data \& API Management: Strong expertise in client\-side state management, data\-fetching strategies, and type\-safe client\-server API contracts across distributed UI modules.
* Build \& DevOps Expertise: Strong understanding of modern frontend build tools (Webpack, Vite) and experience writing/managing CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD highly preferred).
* Quality Engineering: Strong understanding of frontend testing strategies, including unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing with tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, or Cypress.
* Communication: Exceptional interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders, Product Managers, and Backend Architects.
* Platform Engineering Experience: Experience with monorepos, internal package publishing, design systems, Storybook, and reusable developer tooling.
* Frontend Governance: Ability to define and drive standards for theming, accessibility, linting, formatting, dependency management, and architectural consistency across multiple teams.
* AI\-Assisted Development: Hands\-on familiarity with AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, or similar tools, with the ability to define practical usage patterns for engineering teams.


**Good To Have (Preferred Skills)**
* Frontend Observability: Experience instrumenting client\-side RUM, error\-tracking, and distributed tracing (e.g., OpenTelemetry) to support platform reliability metrics.
* Backend for frontend / Lightweight Service Ownership: Familiarity with lightweight Node.js, Express, or equivalent services that support frontend configuration, aggregation, or API composition.
* Legacy Framework Migration: Experience modernizing applications that carry legacy CSS frameworks (e.g., Bootstrap) alongside a component\-driven design system.
* Data Visualization Architecture: Working knowledge of charting libraries (e.g., D3\.js) for teams with heavy analytics or dashboard requirements.
* Package \& Release Governance: Experience with semantic versioning, deprecation policies, private package registries, and consumer migration strategies.


 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.

 NetReveal Technical Lead
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced NetReveal Technical Lead to lead the technical implementation of a high\-volume Transaction Monitoring migration.
   

  

 The role will own the NetReveal technical workstream, including historical data loading, profile generation, scenario execution, batch optimisation and technical readiness. The successful candidate will provide hands\-on leadership to the development team and work closely with Product Owner, Data, Financial Crime, Testing, Architecture and Governance stakeholders.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Lead the end\-to\-end NetReveal technical workstream including interlocks with wider migration programme.
   

  

 Assess the existing NetReveal implementation, processing model, batch schedules and technical constraints.
   

  

 Define the technical approach for loading historical customer, account and transaction data.
   

  

 Design an efficient approach for loading data at scale and reduce the existing method from 20 to 30 days to 5 or 10 days.
   

  

 Define the strategy for customer profile creation, rebuild and reprofiling.
   

  

 Ensure sufficient transaction history is available to support scenario look\-back periods.
   

  

 Evaluate alternative approaches to historical transaction and sequential batch processing.
   

  

 Lead the technical implementation of customer segmentation requirements.
   

  

 Agree the design and lead implementation of a process for customer matching and merging between TSB and Santander records.
   

  

 Assess the impact of the migration on existing NetReveal scenarios, profiles and processing windows.
   

  

 Lead performance tuning, batch optimisation and technical problem resolution.
   

  

 Provide technical direction to NetReveal developers.
   

  

 Review technical designs, code, configuration and deployment artefacts.
   

  

 Work with the Test Lead to define technically representative test scenarios.
   

  

 Agree data controls and certification approach.
   

  

 Produce technical documentation and evidence for design, risk and governance approval.
   

  

 Support cutover planning, implementation, reconciliation and post\-migration assurance.
   

  

**Essential Experience**
 Extensive hands\-on experience implementing or enhancing SymphonyAI NetReveal version 8 or later (version 9 preferred).
   

  

 Strong experience with the Transaction Monitoring SMBD engine using Spark; experience limited to the classic NetReveal TM engine will not be sufficient.
   

  

 Strong understanding of NetReveal data structures, profiling, segmentation, scenarios and batch processing.
   

  

 Experience with customer profile generation, large\-scale reprofiling and migration using the TM SMBD Spark engine.
   

  

 Experience loading significant volumes of historical transaction data into NetReveal.
   

  

 Experience using and analysing Parquet files generated by the TM SMBD Spark engine for profile validation and migration activities.
   

  

 Strong understanding of AML Transaction Monitoring concepts.
   

  

 Experience with scenario look\-back periods, behavioural monitoring and customer segmentation.
   

  

 Strong SQL and data analysis capability.
   

  

 Experience diagnosing performance issues and optimising batch processing.
   

  

 Experience working within a highly governed banking environment.
   

  

 Ability to lead technical delivery while remaining sufficiently hands\-on.

 **Lead Software Developer**

Collaboration is essential, as you will work within a team that follows Scaled Agile methodologies. We are seeking a self\-motivated and delivery\-focused individual with a strong technology background, where experience in AI integrations and prompt engineering will be advantageous, to help us grow our talent and drive innovation in this exciting sector.
   

  

**We will count on you to:**
* Ensure Shared Service requirements are gathered accurately, fully understood, and communicated clearly to all stakeholders, with transparency on impacts and dependencies.
* Design, develop, and support secure, scalable backend and frontend services using Phyton, Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
* Implement authentication and security solutions leveraging JWT, SAML/OIDC, Okta integration, Microsoft EntraID and Passport / Passport\-SAML concepts.
* Build and maintain data persistence layers using Postgresql, MongoDB and Mongoose to deliver robust and reliable application functionality.
* Develop automated tests and support quality assurance practices using Jest, NestJS testing patterns, class\-validator, and class\-transformer. Including documentation, and usage guidance to ensure shared services are easy to adopt, maintain, and support.
* Integrate applications using Express, including body\-parser and cookie\-parser, and work effectively with NestJS guards, hooks, modules, and dependency injection.
* Use Git, npm ecosystem, and environment configuration management effectively to support local development, testing, and delivery.
* Write high\-quality, maintainable code aligned to Agile user stories and established engineering standards, while leveraging AI development productivity tools such as GitHub Copilot where appropriate.
* Troubleshoot and resolve development and integration issues, with a focus on performance, authentication, and service interoperability.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, serving as a role model and supporting their growth within the team.
* Collaborate with peers to foster a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and engineering excellence.
* Champion Agile practices that support effective product delivery and strong team collaboration.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with product owners, solutions architects, analysts, and leadership to ensure alignment of technical solutions with business objectives.
* Leverage emerging technologies, including AI, to solve real\-world challenges and enhance our software solutions.
* Provide technical support to consumers of the Shared Services for existing issues and recommend enhancements to current solutions.


**What is in it for you?**
* Chance to work on enterprise\-grade shared services used by multiple teams (high visibility and impact).
* Exposure to AI integrations and prompt engineering (advantageous/valued experience).
* Work with modern engineering practices: cloud\-native architecture, CI/CD, DevOps quality gates, security\-first delivery.
* A culture of continuous improvement, learning, and knowledge sharing, with scope to grow as a technical leader.


**What you need to have:**
 We are seeking candidates with a proven track record in developing multiple products/services, ideally those that incorporate AI technologies. The ideal candidate will possess:
   

  

* Shared Services Mindset: Demonstrates a strong focus on building reusable components and services that support multiple teams, reduce duplication, and improve consistency across the platform.
* Strong Communication Skills: Ability to effectively interact with both technical and non\-technical colleagues in a cross\-functional environment.
* Strong Self\-Starter and Team Contributor: A proactive individual who takes initiative in their work, embraces a model of continuous learning to stay updated with industry trends and technologies, and actively contributes to team success by collaborating effectively and sharing knowledge with colleagues.
* Diverse Software Delivery Experience: A successful history of delivering software across a variety of languages, technologies, and platforms, with familiarity in AI frameworks and libraries being a plus.
* Agile Methodologies: Experience with Agile at Scale, Lean, and Continuous Delivery methodologies to drive efficient development processes.
* Cloud\-Native Architecture Knowledge: Familiarity with cloud\-native software architectures, particularly in deploying solutions on platforms such as AWS and Microsoft Azure, with an interest in AI applications.
* Security\-Driven Design Practices: Understanding of security\-driven design principles and experience addressing SAST/DAST findings, especially in relation to AI data handling and model security.
* CI/CD and DevOps Proficiency: Proficiency in CI/CD and DevOps practices, including the use of Quality Gates to ensure high code quality.


**Technical Skills or Qualifications Required:**
* Extensive Programming Experience: Proven experience with multiple programming languages and frameworks, with deep expertise in at least one of the following: JavaScript, TypeScript. Familiarity with AI programming languages such as Python is a plus.
* Framework Proficiency: Strong experience with frameworks such as Nest.js, Express.js, and familiarity with AI frameworks like LangFlow or LangChain.
* Prompt Engineering Skills: Solid experience with engineering prompts to effectively interact with AI models, optimizing their performance and output for various applications.
* Testing Expertise: Proficient in Unit Testing and Integration Testing, including the ability to test AI solutions and their integrations effectively.
* Container Technologies: Experience with container technologies like Docker and Kubernetes, to enhance scalability and efficiency.
* Middleware Technologies: Familiarity with any of these middleware technologies such as Kafka, Camunda, Temporal, AWS Lambda Durable function, AWS Step Function and RabbitMQ is needed.
* Design and Development Practices: Demonstrated experience in refactoring, implementing design patterns, design\-driven development, continuous integration, and application security.
* SDLC Knowledge: Solid understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) processes and practices, with experience using tools such as SharePoint, ADO, and GitHub.
* Cloud Infrastructure Experience: Experience designing and deploying applications/shared services on cloud infrastructure with providers like AWS, including S3 storage.
* Stack Knowledge: Knowledge of the MEAN stack, with an interest in leveraging this technology for AI\-driven applications.
* Senior developer with 7\-11 years of experience in software development, solution design and development, plus delivering high\-quality technical projects/services.


**Why join our team:**
* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well\-being.

description:
**Join our Team**
**About The Opportunity**
 Ericsson’s Service Architecture team, within Service Management in the Operate Service Line, is building intelligent automation and decision\-support systems for telecom\-scale managed services. In Software Development, you will design, build, test, and ship production\-grade AI services focused on Agentic AI, LLM integrations, vector retrieval, knowledge graph reasoning, and ML infrastructure. Working with platform engineers, data scientists, and product owners, you will turn AI experiments into reliable services that deliver measurable value across Ericsson’s managed service operations.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Design multi\-agent systems using LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Google ADK, or equivalent orchestration.
* Build LLM services with prompt engineering, tool/function calling, planning, memory, reflection, guardrails, fallback patterns, and RAG.
* Integrate and evaluate commercial API\-based and open\-source/self\-hosted LLMs, balancing cost, latency, accuracy, privacy, and complexity.
* Build RAG pipelines using ChromaDB, Qdrant, Vertex AI RAG, Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, Milvus, or equivalent; manage embeddings, hybrid search, re\-ranking, and index lifecycle.
* Model and query property graphs and RDF/ontologies to enrich agent context, semantic reasoning, and structured retrieval.
* Create evaluation harnesses with automated scoring, human review, A/B testing, and golden datasets.
* Develop ML pipelines for feature engineering, training, evaluation, serving, fine\-tuning, packaging, versioning, and monitoring using Python, PyTorch, scikit\-learn, and HuggingFace.
* Apply ML methods including regression, classification, tree ensembles, boosting, SVMs, neural networks, clustering, PCA/UMAP, LSTMs, and Transformers.
* Monitor model drift, data quality, performance, latency, and token cost in production.
* Build clean, testable Python/PySpark services and REST/FastAPI/Flask/gRPC APIs using clean\-architecture principles.
* Contribute to CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or ArgoCD; participate in reviews, architecture discussions, documentation, runbooks, and mentoring.


**You will bring**
* 6 –15 years of software development experience and a Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or equivalent.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on ML engineering and LLM development experience in production.
* Production experience with Agentic AI, vector database\-backed RAG, and knowledge graph integrations.
* Expert Java/Python; PySpark is desirable. Experience with Spark, SQL, Pandas/Polars, structured streaming, Delta Lake/Iceberg, and Kafka/Pulsar.
* LLM fine\-tuning and optimisation knowledge, including LoRA/QLoRA, RLHF, ONNX, TensorRT, quantisation, and efficient inference.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/Azure/GCP, Databricks or EMR, and MLOps tools such as MLflow or Weights \& Biases.
* Knowledge of LLM observability, structured logging, token\-cost tracking, alerting, responsible AI, and model safety.
* Working knowledge of TOGAF or an equivalent enterprise architecture framework and technical documentation standards.

title: R&D Engineering, Sr Engineer
description:
We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You are someone who looks at a test failure and does not just log it, you dig until you understand why it happened and what it means for the next release. Scripting is not a chore for you, it is how you make repetitive work disappear so you can focus on the problems that actually need a human brain. You have spent enough time in labs or codebases to know that quality is not something you test in at the end, it is something you build into the process from the start.
   

  

 Data tells you stories. When you see a trend in regression results, you do not wait for someone else to notice, you pull the thread, ask the right questions, and surface what matters. You are comfortable working across teams, translating between what verification found, what design needs to know, and what a release checklist actually requires.
   

  

 You do not need years of experience to have a point of view. You know when a process is not working and you are not afraid to suggest a better way. At Synopsys, you will work on Embedded Memory IP that powers the devices people use every day, and the rigor you bring to testing and automation will directly affect whether those products ship on time and work as promised.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Run kickoff and release meetings across design, verification, and release teams, making sure compliance checkpoints are hit and nothing falls through the cracks
* Execute regression testing on Embedded Memory IP, catch issues before they reach customers, and track results across release cycles
* Analyze test data to spot trends, recurring failures, and process gaps that affect product quality or schedule
* Write and maintain Python and Tcl automation scripts that eliminate manual testing steps and speed up validation workflows
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to align on quality gates, release criteria, and issue resolution timelines
* Document test results, failure analysis, and process improvements in a way that helps the next engineer understand what happened and why


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Ensure Embedded Memory IP on advanced process nodes ships with zero critical defects, directly affecting customer success and market readiness
* Reduce validation cycle time by automating repetitive test and data collection tasks, freeing engineers to focus on complex debug work
* Surface quality and process issues early in the development cycle, preventing costly delays and rework downstream
* Improve the reliability of regression infrastructure so teams can trust test results and make faster release decisions
* Strengthen compliance and traceability across the release process, reducing risk and audit friction
* Enable smarter decision\-making by turning raw test data into actionable insights for design and verification teams


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
* 2 years of experience in validation, testing, quality assurance, or a related engineering role
* Working knowledge of Python or Tcl for scripting and automation
* Ability to analyze data, identify patterns, and communicate findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Familiarity with regression testing, release processes, or quality management systems is a plus
* Strong problem\-solving instincts and the ability to work across teams without losing track of details


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can look at a spreadsheet of test results and spot the one anomaly that matters, not just the loudest failure
* You write scripts that other people can actually read and modify six months later
* You are comfortable running a meeting with senior engineers and keeping it focused without being intimidated
* When a process does not make sense, you ask why before you follow it blindly
* You can explain a technical issue to a release manager in two sentences without losing the nuance
* You stay organized when managing multiple release tracks, test cycles, and compliance checkpoints at once


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

description:

**AI Business Solutions – Dynamics F\&SCM Commerce Technical Senior :**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Commerce Technical Senior at EY GDS, you will contribute to the success of enterprise\-scale D365 F\&O implementations, primarily in the Retail and commerce domain. You will have the opportunity to work with a growing team and play a key role in delivering financial transformation solutions, process improvements, and ERP implementations to global clients, helping build a better working world.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain strong client relationships through value\-driven consulting, technical leadership, and proactive engagement.
* Lead the technical design and development of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Commerce solutions, with a focus on POS systems (MPOS/CPOS) \& B2C /B2B Website.
* Configure and extend Store Commerce, Hardware Station, and integrate peripherals such as printers, scanners, cash drawers, and payment devices.
* Configure and extend B2C \& B2B website, Site builder.
* Develop custom POS functionalities using Commerce SDK, Online SDK , TypeScript, JavaScript, C\#, and .NET Core.
* Implement integrations between POS and backend systems: ERP (F\&O), payment gateways, fiscal printers, loyalty programs, and eCommerce platforms.
* Design and maintain offline\-first POS architecture, ensuring performance, fault tolerance, and scalability across store networks.
* Collaborate with functional consultants to translate business needs into detailed technical designs and functional design documents (FDDs).
* Utilize Azure DevOps and Lifecycle Services (LCS) for source control, CI/CD pipelines, and environment management.
* Support system testing, performance tuning, deployment, and go\-live activities.
* Conduct code reviews, enforce best development practices, and maintain thorough technical documentation.
* Provide Level 3 support post\-go\-live to resolve POS\-related issues and ensure smooth store operations.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Familiarity with Power Platform, especially Power Apps and Power BI, is a plus.
* Ability to conceptualize and design future\-state business processes.
* Experience in conducting GAP analysis, solution testing, and user training.
* Good understanding of security roles, data management, Azure DevOps, and LCS environments.


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Knowledge of integration with other Microsoft technologies such as Azure, Power Platform.
* Familiarity with industry\-specific retail practices and compliance requirements.
* Experience working in multi\-country and multi\-legal entity environments.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Proven ability to lead discovery workshops, manage offshore teams, and mentor junior consultants.
* A proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a global, fast\-paced environment.


**What We Look For**
* 5–10 years of experience in D365 Commerce technical.
* Minimum 3 full\-cycle D365 F\&O implementations in Commerce domains.
* Strong domain knowledge of Retail \& eCommerce
* Strong domain knowledge of D365 Site builder tool
* Strong analytical and debugging skills with a focus on performance and reliability.
* Experience with Microsoft SureStep, Agile, or hybrid implementation methodologies.
* Proficiency in working with globally distributed teams and stakeholders.
* Microsoft certifications such as MB\-340, MB\-900 are preferred.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**What You Will Work On** 



* **Seamless patient journeys** 
 — the services behind finding the right doctor, booking a visit, diagnostics, payments, discharge and follow\-up across OPD, IPD, emergency and day care.
* **Products that empower clinicians and caregivers** 
 — technology that assists doctors, nurses and care teams managing heavy patient loads.
* **Platform\-first foundations** 
 — reusable services such as payments, care subscriptions, scheduling and a unified patient record, designed once and used by every product across the network.
* **Voice\-first, touch\-first and AI\-first experiences** 
 — backends for products where people speak instead of type, tap instead of filling forms, and are assisted by AI at every step.
* **A Hospital Information System built from scratch** 
 — the core clinical platform, including EMR, that runs every hospital workflow.
* **Intelligence and interoperability** 
 — AI\-powered services, healthcare data platforms, and integrations with national digital health standards such as ABDM and FHIR.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, build, test and ship backend services and APIs in Java (Spring Boot) or Python (FastAPI), with guidance from senior engineers.
* Write clean, well\-tested and maintainable code; take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback.
* Understand the components of the systems you work on — databases, caches such as Redis, message queues such as Kafka — and why each is used.
* Model data and write efficient queries on relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
* Debug and fix issues across development and production, and contribute to monitoring and reliability.
* Work closely with product managers, designers and senior engineers to understand requirements and the clinical workflows behind them, including occasional visits to our hospitals.
* Ask questions, think independently, and constructively challenge designs when something does not add up.
* Use AI coding assistants and agents throughout development — planning, implementing, testing and refactoring — while owning every line you ship, whether you or an AI wrote it.
* Follow secure coding and data\-privacy practices for systems that handle patient data — audit trails, role\-based access control and encryption of sensitive data, in line with regulations such as the DPDP Act — and strict guardrails so patient information is never exposed to unapproved AI tools.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




***Must have***



* 1–2 years of software development experience at a product company, startup or technology services company, with exposure to a real development workflow — version control, code reviews, testing and deployments.
* Strong computer science fundamentals: data structures and algorithms, object\-oriented programming, databases, and operating systems and networking basics.
* Proficiency in Java or Python.
* Hands\-on use of AI coding assistants and agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) in day\-to\-day development — writing effective prompts, breaking tasks down for an agent, and rigorously reviewing and testing what it produces.
* A clear understanding of the project you currently work on — its design, the components used, and the reasons behind those choices.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, and the ability to explain your thinking clearly while solving a problem.
* Good written and verbal communication.
* A builder's mindset: excited to build from the ground up, comfortable with ambiguity, and keen to take ownership.
* A product mindset — curiosity about how hospitals work, and care for the outcome for the user, not just the ticket.
* Depth over frequent switches — we value engineers who have stayed long enough in a role to learn from it.



***Good to have***



* Hands\-on experience with Spring Boot or FastAPI.
* Exposure to Redis, Kafka, or other caching and messaging systems.
* Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms such as AWS.
* Internships, open\-source contributions, or side projects that have been used by real users.
* Personal or internship projects that use LLM APIs or build simple agents.
* Competitive programming experience.
* Exposure to frontend development (React).



  





**Education** 



* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, IT or a related field from a top\-tier institution (IITs, IIITs, NITs, BITS or equivalent).



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Build from the ground up — a Hospital Information System, shared platforms, and voice\-first and AI\-first products — at the scale of one of India's leading hospital networks.
* Learn in a small, flat, high\-calibre team, with close access to engineering leadership and the Chief Digital Officer.
* An engineering bar and career ladder modelled on India's top product companies, with a clear path for growth.
* See your code used by doctors, nurses and patients — and work alongside some of India's most respected clinicians.
* Access to the latest AI coding tools, and a team that is rethinking how software gets built.
* A tech\-first culture: our own office, a flat and informal environment, and open\-door leadership.
* The energy of a startup with the stability of a profitable, publicly listed healthcare group.

title: Software Development Engineer 4
